## Summary

P25.10 — **`/v1/contradiction` serve-path: bounded latency over an append-only
spine** (ticket `docs/tickets/P25.10__contradiction-serve-path.md`, semantic id
`API-PERF.1`), stacked on `devin/p25-9-meta-closures`.

The defining-standard surface was measured at **~105–131 s per request** on the
hosted API — compute-on-read ran a per-pair read loop over all 17,950 public
(subject, predicate) pairs (~36k SQL round-trips) on every call.

## What changed

- **Profiled first** (recorded in `docs/build/runs/P25.10.md`): the resolver pass
  is 0.10 s in memory; the entire cost was the N+1 — 92.7 ms/pair through the
  proxy. The fix pushes the set-based work into SQL FIRST (one fetch of all
  public claims, grouped in memory) — no wrong-shaped query got cached.
- **`PgReadStore`**: `_public_claim_groups` (single set-based SELECT, same
  `sensitivity_tier = 0` boundary + `sys_period @> belief` as-of predicate) +
  `_spine_watermark` (`count(claim)` + closed-period count + latest assertion
  instant + evidence-table counts — monotone under insert-only, the one
  permitted `sys_period`-close mutation included) + a lock-guarded per-instance
  memo on a dedicated read connection + `warmup()` daemon thread wired into
  `sig-api serve`.
- **Freshness disclosed**: `spine_watermark` on `ContradictionCollection`,
  `ContradictionResponse`, `TaskCollection`, `TaskResponse` — a cached answer
  states the spine state it describes.
- **Invalidation proven**: `test_watermark_keyed_serve_path_discloses_and_invalidates`
  adds a contradiction-producing claim via `PgClaimSink` and shows the endpoint
  reflects it (watermark bump → exactly one recompute) — the cache can never
  serve a stale set.
- `/v1/task` shared the same compute-on-read pass — now the same cached view.

## Verification

- Hosted (`sig-api-00002-b55`): **before 113.6 s / 131.5 s; after cold 1.01 s,
  warm 0.17–0.24 s** — warm p95 < 5 s met (~20x headroom). Served set
  byte-identical (same `contradiction_id` + `claim_ids`).
- `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 pytest tests/api/test_store_pg.py` — 4/4 (real
  testcontainer, not skipped).
- `make check` green: 3137 passed / 2 skipped, lint/format/mypy/verify-gen clean.
- Invariants: spine insert-only, RLS/`SET ROLE` untouched, reads read-only, no
  sqitch change needed (in-process memo, no derived store required at ~1 s
  compute), no secrets in files.

Requirement ids: `API-PERF.1` (P25.10 acceptance criteria 1–5).
